_comment: tests/benchmark/hook_latency.py on held-out task 0cb3760383's index (hermes-agent, built by v4.22.1) and prompt (bench/task_outcome/hermes-agent-test-ranking/heldout/tasks.json). 'before' is main at 50e410b0 on PYTHONPATH with --states uncached; 'after' is this release. Reproduce: python -m tests.benchmark.hook_latency <index> --tasks bench/task_outcome/hermes-agent-test-ranking/heldout/tasks.json --task 0cb3760383 --label hermes-agent-0cb3760383 --runs 5

before.prompt: My session is running on Anthropic (`https://api.anthropic.com` with my Anthropic key). My config has no `model.base_url`, but `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is set in my environment. When I switch the session's model with provider `custom` (e.g. `/model m2 --provider custom`, or when the per-turn config sync picks up `provider: custom`), the switch succeeds but the session now points at OpenRouter's default endpoint with my OpenRouter key, a host I never chose. When a custom endpoint is configured in `model.base_url`, switching to `custom` from another provider correctly uses that endpoint. But when no custom endpoint is configured, the switch should keep the session's current endpoint and API key (here `https://api.anthropic.com` and my Anthropic key) instead of falling through to OpenRouter.
